hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s re-election bid and economic defense
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei launched an aggressive political defense of his economic austerity and reform package ahead of critical congressional votes. Amid mounting internal friction within La Libertad Avanza and public spats with journalists, Milei rallied lawmakers at Casa Rosada, demanding strict adherence to his fiscal trajectory while defending cabinet members facing judicial scrutiny.
hotspots.affect: High affective investment stems from Milei's fiery, combative rhetoric against political opponents and the press, framed around a high-stakes battle to protect his economic agenda.

hotspots.title: AfD’s rise and far-right governance threats in Germany
hotspots.blurb: Support for the Alternative for Germany (AfD) has surged to over 40% in state polling ahead of upcoming elections in Saxony-Anhalt, provoking widespread alarm across Germany. Mainstream leaders warn that an AfD electoral victory poses severe economic and social risks, while AfD figures double down on aggressive campaign rhetoric and challenge the political 'firewall' against them.
hotspots.affect: Driven by widespread establishment anxiety over far-right political gains, intense media scrutiny, and escalating rhetoric over democratic norms.

hotspots.title: Trump administration’s visa and immigration crackdown
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration executed a sudden pause on global immigrant visa appointments, citing mandatory consular staff training on stricter public-charge screening rules. This measure, combined with proposed fee hikes for H-1B visas and expanding enforcement actions, has sparked renewed legal challenges and intense partisan debate.
hotspots.affect: Commands disproportionate focus due to severe real-world impacts on global travelers and legal applicants, combined with heated ideological clashes over executive power.

hotspots.title: Italy’s Salvini pushes budget deficit and fuel tax battles
hotspots.blurb: Italian Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini is pushing a controversial €20 billion financial maneuver funded by extra-profit taxes on banks and energy companies to offset rising living costs. Salvini's aggressive economic demands have amplified internal friction within the ruling right-wing coalition alongside disagreements with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.
hotspots.affect: Fueled by sharp intra-coalition discord, public economic anxiety, and high-stakes maneuvering between competing right-wing party leaders.

hotspots.title: Trump administration threatens Kennedy Center demolition
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration sparked intense public controversy after threatening to demolish the historic John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts unless major structural repairs and naming updates are completed. The stance follows ongoing disputes between federal officials and the cultural institution's leadership.
hotspots.affect: Generates sharp emotional investment through shock framing surrounding the potential destruction of a national landmark amidst ongoing culture war disputes.
